BrochureContent.Content:
Extending to c. 71 sq. m. (765 sq ft), the apartment is presented in good condition. The entrance hallway leads to the large living room space which has a southerly orientation allowing natural light to flood the space. The living room overlooks the trees and Christchurch and St Audeon`s Church. Off the living room is a separate kitchen while the2 bedrooms are located to the rear of the apartment just off the hallway. There are 2 bathrooms and a large storage space. The apartment also benefits from one designated car parking space. 

Situated in a convenient city centre location, Cook Street is within walking distance of a host of amenities including cafés, restaurants, shops, cultural attractions and excellent public transport links. Temple Bar, Christchurch, St. Stephen`s Green and the LUAS are all within easy reach. There are views over Christchurch and St Audeon`s Park and Church.

Features


Spacious Second floor apartment

Two bedrooms / two bathrooms

Approx. 71 sq.m. / 765 sq.ft

South-facing balcony
Semi-solid wooden flooring

One designated car parking space

Excellent Dublin 8 location

Walking distance to city centre amenities and transport links

Accommodation is as follows:

Entrance Hallway:
Bright entrance hallway running through the spine of the property leading to the living room. There is a storage cupboard in the hallway.

Living/Dining Room:
Large bright open plan living/dining area with semi-solid wooden floors. Light floods into this space thanks to a floor to ceiling window which leads to the south facing balcony. There is ample room for a dining table and chairs. There is an electric fire in this space. 

Kitchen:
Tiled floor and partly tiled walls with ample wall and floor units. There is a double galzed window which allows natural light and ventilation into this space. Plumbed for washer/dryer, fridge-freezer and electric oven and hob. 

Bedroom One:
Large double bedroom with semi-solid wooden floors and builit-in double wardrobes. 

En Suite Bathroom:
Tiled floor with shower cubicle and partly tiled walls, WC and wash hand basin with shaving light and extractor fan. 

Bedroom Two: 
Large double bedroom with semi-solid wooden floors and builit-in 2 x double wardrobes with ample hanging and drawer space. 

Main bathroom:
Large bright bathroom with tiled floor and partly tiled walls. Bath with shower attachment, WC, wash hand basin with shaving light and extractor fan. There is a window here which allows natural light and ventilation into this space.

Notice
Please note we have not tested any apparatus, fixtures, fittings, or services. Interested parties must undertake their own investigation into the working order of these items. All measurements are approximate and photographs provided for guidance only.
